name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos Project in the Salta province of Argentina, one of the largest undeveloped silver-gold deposits in the country. The company has advanced the project through environmental approvals and updated resource estimates, and was approved under Argentina's RIGI Large Investment Incentive Regime. It also holds an earn-in option on the La Coipita project in San Juan, Argentina.
